name: HIPAA Breach Notification Rule: presumption, clocks and notices
description: HIPAA Breach Notification Rule: presumption, clocks and notices. From the Shio policy pack specification; draft, not reviewed.
limits: Draft and unreviewed. Planned controls are listed for coverage and not enforced.

controls.title: An impermissible use is presumed a breach unless a documented four-factor assessment shows
controls.requirement: An impermissible use is presumed a breach unless a documented four-factor assessment shows low probability of compromise.

controls.title: Each store and channel records whether HHS-recognised protection applies (unsecured PHI)
controls.requirement: Each store and channel records whether HHS-recognised protection applies (unsecured PHI).

controls.title: An incident starts a notification clock at discovery: individuals within 60 calendar days
controls.requirement: An incident starts a notification clock at discovery: individuals within 60 calendar days.

controls.title: 500 or more
controls.requirement: 500 or more: HHS and media within 60 days; fewer: logged and reported within 60 days of year end.

controls.title: A business associate notifies the covered entity within 60 days
controls.requirement: A business associate notifies the covered entity within 60 days, or the agreement's shorter period.

controls.title: Shorter state breach deadlines from the state table replace the federal one
controls.requirement: Shorter state breach deadlines from the state table replace the federal one.

controls.title: Every notification
controls.requirement: Every notification, risk assessment and delay is signed and retained six years.
